answer: Hold every new agent's rewards in an oasis-style escrow vault that vests over 30 epochs, and let any flagged identity forfeit the unvested balance. With 10% daily vesting capped, each extra fake must wait and risk its own pile, so farming 100 fakes locks up 100x the capital, like ivory tied up in a vault. Weakness: patient attackers with deep pockets can still wait out the vesting.
